constraints: Generic engine must have no glass package or shader dependency.
Civ3 owns the application shader module and selects its glass plugin.
Tile and glass tests compile independent test shader modules.
Preserve existing GitHub prototype before replacing the Civ3 destination.
The original monorepo and dataset source/evidence are not deleted.
